title: Colorful way to show your American pride!
text: Colorful way to show your American pride!. This was a great set to help decorate my golf cart for the local 4th of July golf cart parade. Lots of colorful patriotic items which actually are pretty well made. This is perfect for my cart, the little flags look great along the sides. The lanterns are really cute too.

product_metadata.title: D-buy 6 Pack 4th of July Cloth Lanterns Patriotic Decorations Red White and Blue Lanterns Outdoor Decorations for 4th of July Memorial Day Decorations
features: QUANTITY: This 4th of July patriotic decorations set includes: 6 red, white and blue cloth lanterns for 4th of July. There are 2 cloth lanterns of each color. Every patriotic cloth lantern is colorful and easy to use. It can better assist you to decorate your patriotic party and increase the atmosphere of patriotic festivals, allowing you to enjoy 4th of July, Memorial Day, Veterans Day or other patriotic theme parties.

SIZE: Patriotic cloth lanterns come in 3 sizes, 12" (1 * blue lantern & 1 * red lantern), 10" (1 * blue lantern & 1 * white lantern), and 8" (1 * red lantern & 1 * white lantern). Ample patriotic decorative materials help you better create a decoration full of American spirit and atmosphere.

MATERIAL: These lantern patriotic decorations are made of high-quality cloth. The lanterns are bright in color and are not easy to fade or break. These lantern globes have a unique design that allows them to fold flat and expand into large globes. They can be used repeatedly and folded up for storage.

GREAT PATRIOTIC DECORATIONS: These big beautiful patriotic lanterns and American flag banner can be used as hanging decorations, great for 4th of July, Independence Day, Memorial Day picnic and American theme party. Also great for Veterans Day, Labor Day party, Flag Day, Military Homecoming, a political rally, firework party or any other patriotic theme celebration to show your American pride and patriotic spirit.

WIDE APPLICATION: With this set of red, white and blue patriotic cloth lanterns, you can easily create impressive festive patriotic decorations whether you are in your home, office, restaurant, mall, classroom, outdoor, garden or patio decoration. You only need to hang red, white and blue lanterns to decorate party areas, gardens, patio, walls, windows, fences, porches, balconies, terraces, classrooms, and strong patriotic holiday atmosphere comes.
